Result Count Meaning MATCH 29 the cited vendored cell equals the claimed value BLANK 8 the cited cell is empty and the claim says blank/false/0 UNCHECKABLE 26 cites the 2023 cr-csv data, a wiki, or an official post; none of them is vendored FLAGGED 5 none contradicts the vendored data. 4 are LIVE-vintage values (Fireball pushback 1000 since 2022; Arrows damage per wave 48, per-arrow radius 1400, 10 arrows per wave) citing a 2023-data cell whose name also exists in 2018 (2018 values: 1800, 115, 4000, 15). 1 is Zap MaximumTargets blank = unlimited.

The trap that exposes. The spec tags both 2018-data and live-2026 numbers as DATA, and the file the engine reads is not tied to either. CardDb::load_repo opens data/derived/cards.json whatever vintage last landed there, and data/derived/ is gitignored except for the committed cards-15.535.json, so THE NAME DOES NOT CARRY THE VINTAGE. The published recipe (README, stage 3) copies the committed data/derived/cards-15.535.json to cards.json, so a clone has the LIVE 15.535.29 tables under that name, and it runs extract_cards.py --vintage 2018 with no --out, which writes the 2018 tables beside it as cards-2018.json. extract_cards.py with no --vintage also writes the 15.535.29 tables to cards.json, but it needs the client's asset pack. Which table sits under that name also decides whether the ledger's measured card values apply: cards.CLIENT16402_VALUES corrects the 15.535.29 table (cards-15535.1) and no other. Read provenance.vintage inside the file rather than trusting its name. Note also that globals.csv and the fallback rarities.csv are include_str!d from data/raw/retroroyale-2018/ unconditionally (state.rs, card.rs), so a checkout carrying the 15.535 cards is ALREADY a mix: live card stats against 2018 globals. Implement each mechanic generally enough to express both (e.g. Arrows as N waves of M sub-projectiles, not one 4000-millitile circle) and feed it the 2018 data, so a vintage mix cannot happen silently. Record live values as calibration evidence, not as inputs, and carry the vintage beside every number.

Tags: DATA = shipped column (check which data), COMMUNITY = wiki/official post, INFERENCE = this spec's reading.

What is implemented against this spec, and what is not, is in mechanics.md; the ledger keys it proposes live in data/calibration.json under spells.*, status.* and knockback.* (calibration.md).

Behaviour, in order

  1. VALIDATE: cost 4 elixir [DATA spells_other.Fireball.ManaCost]. Territory Anywhere: enemy side, river, on top of buildings/towers all legal [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball 25/4/2018 river; DATA cr-csv 2023 CanPlaceOnWater/CanDeployOnEnemySide/CanPlaceOnBuildings TRUE]. The 2017-derived spell.can_deploy_on_enemy_side=false and can_place_on_buildings=false are BLANK cells, not facts: do not consume them [INFERENCE]. arena.rs deploy_zone already returns Ok for Territory::Anywhere before the water check.

  2. COMMIT: elixir spent and card cycled at the command, as for troops [INFERENCE: engine convention].

  3. LAUNCH: in the first Spawn phase after the command (same latency as a troop, so both teams' same-tick casts materialise together) create one spell projectile: team = caster, source entity = caster King Tower [COMMUNITY wiki King's Tower: spell damage 'originates from the King Tower and technically counts as an attack by it'], pos = launch point (calibration spells.LAUNCH_POINT, default caster king tower centre arena.rs::king_tower_pos) [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: 'travel time ... depending on how far it is sent from the King's Tower'], aim = tap point, fixed [DATA Homing blank], no pre-launch delay [DATA CustomDeployTime blank].

  4. FLIGHT: each Projectile phase advance by 600 * projectile.SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK along the straight ground segment with fractional carry (path.rs::advance). Gravity 50 is treated as visual (key projectile.FLIGHT_PATH) [INFERENCE]. Flight is never blocked or deflected in the thin slice [INFERENCE; DeflectBehaviour is Monk-only].

  5. IMPACT HIT TEST, evaluated on the arrival tick with positions as they are then, not at cast [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: troops at the edge at launch 'may not be hit by the time the spell actually lands']: every live entity that is an enemy of the caster [DATA OnlyEnemies], air or ground [DATA AoeToAir, AoeToGround], with centre distance <= 45000 subtiles + victim collision radius (edge-inclusive, as combat.rs::splash does today; key spells.AOE_HIT_TEST) [INFERENCE]. A crown tower is reached by a square instead: the distance from the spell's point to a square of half-side 1000 native round the tower's centre, strictly below the spell's radius (spells.CROWN_TOWER_SPELL_REACH = client_square_1000_strict, measured on client 15.535.29). Skip hidden entities (underground Tesla) once hiding exists [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: Tesla 'immune to it while underground'; DATA projectiles.csv has no AffectsHidden, AEO AffectsHidden TRUE only on Freeze].

  6. DAMAGE into the damage buffer: level-scaled damage (325 at level 1 of the 2017 Rare table) to troops and non-crown buildings (Cannon, Tesla) in full [COMMUNITY wiki 'quite effective versus buildings']. Crown towers (princess and king) take dmg + trunc_toward_zero(dmg * CTDP / 100) = ceil(dmg * pct / 100), with CTDP -60 in the 2017 vintage [DATA; law: COMMUNITY, Supercell published L11 values fit 7/7 non-circular points vs 3 for floor]. A king tower hit triggers activation (already in engine) [COMMUNITY wiki King's Tower].

  7. KNOCKBACK SELECTION (buffered like damage, never applied inline): among the step-5 victims, every TROOP (never a building or crown tower: no Speed column) [DATA; INFERENCE] whose ignore_pushback is false, because PushbackAll is false for Fireball [DATA; decoded: only Log/Monk/MegaCannon ship PushbackAll TRUE and the wiki names exactly Log, Monk and Little Prince as pushing 'all ground troops']. Air units are included [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: Balloon 'knocked away', Inferno Dragon ramp reset]. Thin slice live: pushed = Knight, Archer, Musketeer, HogRider, Minion, BabyDragon, Valkyrie, Skeleton, Wizard; not pushed = Giant, Prince.

  8. KNOCKBACK VECTOR: unit(victim.pos - impact point) * Pushback (32400 subtiles for the 2017 vintage, 18000 live) [DATA Pushback = distance; COMMUNITY radial: wiki 'place ... on the side of the troop opposite to where the player would like to redirect it']. Integer normalisation: i64 isqrt, remainder handling ours. Zero vector (victim exactly on the impact point): key knockback.ZERO_VECTOR_DIRECTION, and it must be mirror-symmetric (for example the caster's forward y) [INFERENCE; crforge's fixed (0,+1) for both teams breaks the 180-degree seat symmetry]. Two knockbacks landing on one unit in the same tick are combined by an order-independent rule (key knockback.STACKING, default vector sum) [INFERENCE].

  9. KNOCKBACK MOTION: the displacement is spread over knockback.DURATION_MS (0 = instant) [INFERENCE; no data key in 2017 or 2023]. During it the unit neither walks nor attacks, and an attack windup in progress is reset to Idle (not paused like a stun) [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: 'a true stun that resets the attack animations'; wiki The Log: 'will reset their attack animation']. The target is not force-cleared; ordinary retargeting applies afterwards [COMMUNITY wiki Fireball: Rascal Boy 'possibly causing him to retarget'; VH2018: Sparky no longer resets after being knocked out of range].

  10. KNOCKBACK TERRAIN: the river does not block the displacement [COMMUNITY wiki The Log: push 'the unit over the river back to the opponent's side']. A ground unit left on a water cell is resolved by knockback.WATER_RESOLUTION [COMMUNITY VH2020: hover units 'When knocked into the river, they will no longer bounce off of it', which implies ground units do bounce]. Clamp to arena bounds [INFERENCE].

  11. RESOLVE/REAP as usual: deaths from the damage buffer; the projectile is removed on its arrival tick. A unit killed this tick is not displaced (displacement is irrelevant once it is dead) [INFERENCE].

Targets affected. Air and ground enemy troops (damage plus knockback, except IgnorePushback units, which take damage only); enemy non-crown buildings (Cannon, Tesla) take full damage and are never displaced; enemy crown towers (princess and king) take reduced damage (2017 data 40%, live 23% as of 2026-09-08) and are never displaced; hitting the king tower activates it. No friendly fire (OnlyEnemies) on own troops, buildings or towers. Knockback is troops only; PushbackAll=false so immune units stay put (live thin slice: Giant, Prince). Air units are pushed.

Unsettled

  • LAUNCH POINT. Candidates: (L1) caster king tower centre (9,3)/(9,29); (L2) king centre offset toward the target by KingTower ProjectileStartRadius 750 mt; (L3) an off-screen point behind the king. Decide by casting Fireball at 3 or more distances in at least 2 directions, timestamping the frame the fireball first appears and the explosion frame, then fitting t = |aim - L| / v (the intercept separates L from command latency).
  • PROJECTILE SPEED UNITS. Candidates: Speed/60 tiles/s (AesDragon assertion, crforge, same as the troop /60 camp) vs Speed/50 (Darknighture frame test: Musketeer projectile Speed 1000 moved 20 tiles/s; also cites Giant 54 tiles/min at Speed 45). No source found for the claim 'troops /50, projectiles /60'. Decide by the same flight-time regression: over 23 tiles the two predict 2.32 s vs 1.93 s. Measure projectile and troop divisors independently; do not assume they share units.
  • FLIGHT PATH LENGTH. Candidates: straight 2D ground distance vs ballistic arc length from Gravity 50. Decide: if flight time vs ground distance is linear through the intercept, the path is 2D.
  • AOE HIT TEST. Candidates: edge-inclusive (dist <= 2.5 tiles + victim collision radius; engine convention) vs centre-in-radius. Decide: stationary Knight (r 0.5) with its centre at 2.8 tiles from the impact is hit under edge, missed under centre.
  • CROWN-TOWER ROUNDING. Candidates: ceil(dmgpct/100) == dmg + trunc0(dmgCTDP/100) (fits every Supercell-published value: 207@30, 172@25, 31@25, 25@20, 371@25, 58@30, 48@25); floor (engine today, fits 3/8); round half-up (5/8). The evidence is patch-note stat sheets, not in-battle numbers. Decide by reading the princess tower HP number before and after a Fireball impact in a recording.
  • KNOCKBACK DISPLACEMENT LAW. Candidates: (K1) fixed Pushback regardless of distance from centre; (K2) linear falloff with distance; (K3) crforge's speed=P/1s for 0.5 s, which moves only P/2. Supercell words it as 'Pushback: 1.8 tile -> 1 tile', which favours K1. Decide: frame-track Knights at 0.5 and 2.3 tiles from the impact and compare final displacements.
  • KNOCKBACK DURATION and incapacitation window. Candidates: instant; constant velocity over D ms (crforge D=500, unsourced). Decide: frame-count the displacement at 60 fps.
  • ZERO-VECTOR DIRECTION. Candidates: caster forward y; projectile travel direction (impact - launch); no push. Decide: Fireball centred exactly on a stationary unit.
  • WATER RESOLUTION after a push into the river. Candidates: eject to nearest land cell; continue to the far bank along the push; clamp at the bank. Decide: Fireball a Knight standing 0.3 tiles from the bank, off-bridge.
  • KNOCKBACK OF DEPLOYING UNITS (deploy_ms > 0). Community evidence shows deploying units take spell damage (wiki Arrows vs Goblin Barrel; standard Fireball-on-placement play), but not whether they are pushed. Decide: Fireball a Musketeer on its placement frame.
  • IgnorePushback VINTAGE. The 2017 flags are stale for BabyDragon (and Balloon, InfernoDragon, BattleRam); 2023 data agrees with the wiki changes. Which vintage the engine loads is a project decision, not a measurement (the target is live 2026).

Engine test ideas (each with its plant)

  • fireball_flight_ticks_equal_distance_over_speed: Blue casts at a point D subtiles from Blue king centre; assert the damage tick = spawn tick + ceil(D / (600*mult)). PLANT spell_instant (damage applied at the tap tick) and PLANT launch_from_tap_point must fail it.
  • fireball_hit_test_is_at_impact_not_cast: an enemy Hog Rider walking out of the radius during flight takes 0 damage, while a unit that walks in takes full damage. PLANT hit_test_at_cast.
  • fireball_radius_edge_inclusive: Knight centres at exactly 45000+9000 subtiles (hit) and +1 subtile (miss). PLANT aoe_centre_to_centre.
  • fireball_crown_tower_uses_ceil_law: princess tower hit by a 688-damage Fireball with CTDP -70 loses exactly 207; with -75 loses 172; with -77 loses 159. PLANT ct_floor (combat.rs::damage_against as today) reports 206 and 158.
  • fireball_knockback_radial_fixed_distance: Knight 1 tile due east of the impact ends exactly +Pushback in x and 0 in y once knockback completes, with no other motion (for example DURATION 0, or the Knight has no target). PLANT no_knockback; PLANT knockback_half_distance (crforge law).
  • fireball_respects_ignore_pushback_and_pushback_all: Giant and Prince in radius keep their positions bit-identically and take damage; the same test with a projectile whose pushback_all=true moves them. PLANT ignore_flag_not_read (card.rs never loads ignore_pushback today, so the test is a live specification).
  • fireball_never_moves_buildings: Cannon, Tesla and princess tower inside the radius keep positions bit-identically. PLANT push_buildings.
  • fireball_only_enemies: own Knight and own princess tower inside the radius take 0 damage and 0 displacement. PLANT friendly_fire.
  • fireball_pushes_air: Minion in radius is damaged and displaced; BabyDragon too when loaded from live-vintage flags. PLANT air_immune_to_knockback.
  • fireball_knockback_resets_windup: Musketeer mid-windup when hit fires strictly later than an unhit control Musketeer; attack_phase goes to Idle, not paused. PLANT knockback_pauses_like_stun.
  • fireball_mirror_symmetry_including_zero_vector: Blue Fireball at (x,y) onto a Red Knight exactly at the impact vs Red Fireball at (x,32-y) onto a Blue Knight; final states are mirror images. PLANT zero_vector_plus_y (fixed +y for both teams, as crforge does).
  • two_fireballs_same_tick_order_independent: Blue and Red spells (or two Blue casts) landing on one unit in the same tick give the same state_hash whichever is enqueued first. PLANT sequential_knockback (apply inline in slot order).
  • knockback_into_river_never_leaves_ground_unit_in_water: after the knockback completes, no ground unit centre is on a water cell. PLANT no_water_resolution.
  • save_load_mid_flight_and_mid_knockback: snapshot while the projectile is in flight and while a unit is mid-knockback; the loaded run reproduces state_hash for 200 ticks. PLANT save_drops_spell_projectiles, PLANT save_drops_knockback_timer.

docs.title: Arrows
docs.text:
Data chain. 2017 vintage (the vendored data): cards.json cards[name=Arrows].spell.first_projectile (= spells_other.Arrows.CustomFirstProjectile -> projectiles.ArrowsSpell) -> .damage 115, .radius_milli 4000, .speed 800, .homing true, .crown_tower_damage_percent 40 (raw -60), .aoe_to_air/.aoe_to_ground true, .only_enemies true, .pushback_milli null; cards[Arrows].spell.multiple_projectiles 15 (spells_other.Arrows.MultipleProjectiles, visual count); cards[Arrows].spell.radius_milli 4000 (spells_other.Arrows.Radius); cards[Arrows].projectile = ArrowsSpellDeco (spells_other.Arrows.Projectile), damage null, VISUAL ONLY and never the damage source; cards[Arrows].elixir 3. Live vintage (not vendored): smlbiobot/cr-csv 2023 spells_other.Arrows.{Projectile=ArrowsSpell, ProjectileWaves 3, ProjectileWaveInterval 200, MultipleProjectiles 10, Radius 4000} -> projectiles.ArrowsSpell.{Damage 48, Radius 1400, Speed 1100, CTDP -70, HideWhenDelayed TRUE}; Supercell 2025-03-04 radius 3500; Supercell 2026-06-01 CT 20%.

Numbers

name value units tag source elixir cost 3 elixir DATA spells_other.Arrows.ManaCost (2017 and 2023) damage per hit, level 1, 2017 vintage (single hit) 115 hp DATA projectiles.ArrowsSpell.Damage via spells_other.Arrows.CustomFirstProjectile waves, 2017 vintage 1 damage events COMMUNITY wiki Arrows 26/11/2019 'three volleys of Arrows instead of one'; 2017 spells_other.csv has no ProjectileWaves column MultipleProjectiles (2017) 15 (1 damaging CustomFirstProjectile + deco arrows; visual only) projectile count DATA spells_other.Arrows.MultipleProjectiles; cross-card: characters.Princess MultipleProjectiles 5 + CustomFirstProjectile PrincessProjectile + Projectile PrincessProjectileDeco (damage-less) radius, 2017 vintage 4000 = 72000 subtiles millitiles DATA projectiles.ArrowsSpell.Radius and spells_other.Arrows.Radius projectile Speed raw 800 (2017; raised from 600 on 13/3/2017); 1100 live (since 2019-06-03) raw Speed DATA projectiles.ArrowsSpell.Speed 2017; cr-csv 2023 1100; wiki Arrows history projectile speed in engine units 800: 12000 (x15) or 14400 (x18); 1100: 16500 (x15) or 19800 (x18) subtiles per tick INFERENCE derived; same unit dispute as Fireball Homing true, but inert for a position-targeted spell boolean INFERENCE projectiles.ArrowsSpell.Homing TRUE (2017, 2023); inertness inferred CrownTowerDamagePercent raw (2017) -60 -> 40% percent delta from 100 DATA projectiles.ArrowsSpell.CrownTowerDamagePercent; wiki 40% until 12/12/2017 crown tower percent, live history 35% (2017-12-12), 30% (2020-08-04), 25% (2024-08-06), 20% (2026-06-01, Supercell 'Arrows: 93 -> 75', i.e. 3 x 31 -> 3 x 25 at L11) percent COMMUNITY wiki Arrows history; supercell.com june-balance-changes-2026 waves, live 3 damage events per cast DATA cr-csv 2023 spells_other.Arrows.ProjectileWaves; wiki 26/11/2019 wave interval, live 200 = 4 ticks at TICK_MS 50 ms DATA cr-csv 2023 spells_other.Arrows.ProjectileWaveInterval damage per wave, level 1, live 48 (L11: 122) hp DATA cr-csv 2023 projectiles.ArrowsSpell.Damage; cr-api-data damage_per_level L11 122; wiki dmg_11 122 sub-area radius per arrow, live 1400 = 25200 subtiles millitiles DATA cr-csv 2023 projectiles.ArrowsSpell.Radius; wiki 26/10/2022 'multiple 1.4-tiles areas instead of one 4-tiles area ... effective Attack Radius remained unchanged' arrows per wave, live 10 (whether each carries damage with per-unit dedupe is unsettled) projectiles DATA cr-csv 2023 spells_other.Arrows.MultipleProjectiles effective spell radius, live 3500 = 63000 subtiles (4000 until 2025-03-04) millitiles COMMUNITY supercell.com march-balance-changes (4 Mar 2025) 'Radius: 4 tiles -> 3.5 tiles' crown tower damage per wave, level 11 live 25 hp COMMUNITY Supercell June 2026 '75' total / 3 waves pushback none - DATA projectiles.ArrowsSpell.Pushback blank (2017, 2023) AoeToAir / AoeToGround / OnlyEnemies true / true / true boolean DATA projectiles.ArrowsSpell; spells_other.Arrows.OnlyEnemies example flight time king centre to enemy princess centre (23.16 tiles), Speed 1100 1.263 s / 26 ticks (/60) vs 1.053 s / 22 ticks (/50); first wave, later waves +200 ms each s / ticks INFERENCE arithmetic on the row above

Behaviour, in order

  1. VALIDATE and COMMIT exactly as Fireball: 3 elixir, Territory Anywhere [DATA spells_other.Arrows.ManaCost; COMMUNITY wiki 25/4/2018 river; DATA cr-csv 2023 CanPlaceOnWater/CanDeployOnEnemySide TRUE].

  2. RESOLVE THE DAMAGING PROJECTILE FROM DATA, NOT FROM cards[Arrows].projectile: when spell.first_projectile (CustomFirstProjectile) exists it is the only damage carrier; spell.projectile (ArrowsSpellDeco) and the remaining MultipleProjectiles are visual and deal nothing [DATA cross-card Princess pattern; COMMUNITY 2017 Arrows was one hit]. When the row has no CustomFirstProjectile (2023+), Projectile itself carries the damage [DATA cr-csv 2023].

  3. WAVES: N = spells_other.ProjectileWaves, defaulting to 1 when the column is absent (2017), 3 live; interval = ProjectileWaveInterval ms, defaulting to 0 (200 live) [DATA 2023]. In the first Spawn phase after the command create wave 0; wave i is released iinterval ms later (4 ticks at 50 ms), hidden until then [DATA HideWhenDelayed TRUE]. All waves fly from the same launch point (spells.LAUNCH_POINT) to the same tap point, so their impacts are exactly iinterval apart [INFERENCE].

  4. FLIGHT: as Fireball, Speed 800 (2017) or 1100 (live) times the projectile multiplier; Homing TRUE is inert because the aim is a fixed position with no target entity [INFERENCE].

  5. PER-WAVE IMPACT, each evaluated on its own arrival tick with current positions: enemies only [DATA OnlyEnemies], air and ground [DATA], the same edge-inclusive hit test as Fireball [INFERENCE]. Area model per key arrows.WAVE_AREA_MODEL. Default W1: one disc of the spell radius (4000 in 2017, 3500 live) centred on the tap point, each enemy hit AT MOST ONCE per wave [COMMUNITY wiki Arrows: '2 volleys eliminate ... Goblins' and 'a single volley is enough to take out Skeletons'; Supercell 93 = 3 x 31 for towers]. W2, explicit 10 sub-areas of 1400 with per-wave dedupe, is available for when the pattern is measured.

  6. DAMAGE per wave: level-scaled damage (115 at level 1 in 2017; 48 live) to troops and non-crown buildings; crown towers take the same ceil law as Fireball with CTDP -60 (2017) [DATA; law COMMUNITY]. Every wave that touches the king tower counts as king damage (activation) [COMMUNITY wiki King's Tower].

  7. NO KNOCKBACK, NO STATUS: positions and attack phases of hit units are untouched [DATA no Pushback, no TargetBuff].

  8. Waves are independent: a unit killed by wave 0 is not a target for wave 1, and a unit that enters the area before wave 2 lands takes wave 2 only [INFERENCE, follows from step 5 evaluating at arrival]. Remove each wave on its arrival tick; the cast is complete after wave N-1.

Targets affected. Air and ground enemy troops; enemy non-crown buildings (full damage); enemy crown towers (reduced: 40% in 2017 data, 20% live since 2026-06-01), once per wave. No friendly fire. No knockback and no stun on anything. King tower hits activate the king.

Unsettled

  • WAVE AREA MODEL (live). Candidates: (W1) one disc of spell Radius per wave with one hit per unit; (W2) 10 explicit 1.4-tile sub-areas per wave with per-unit dedupe; (W3) W2 without dedupe (a unit under overlapping sub-areas takes several hits per wave). The wiki's '2 volleys eliminate Goblins' (Goblin L11 hp 204, wave 122) argues against W3. Geometric note [INFERENCE, covering constant from recollection, not verified]: 10 discs of r=1.4 cannot cover a disc of r=4.0 (ratio 0.35 < ~0.43), so W2 at the 2023 radius must leave rim gaps, while at live 3.5 with a 0.5 victim radius (1.9/4.0 = 0.475) it can cover. Decide by casting Arrows repeatedly on Skeletons (one-hit kill) spaced at radii 2.5-3.9 tiles and at several angles; a fixed gap pattern means W2.
  • WAVE RELEASE. Candidates: all waves launch together and land together while their damage is delayed, vs launch i*200 ms apart. These differ only in whether the delay is applied before or after flight; the impact spacing is the same. Decide by frame-timing the three hit flashes against the cast frame at two distances.
  • WHICH VINTAGE LOADS. The 2017 data describes a mechanically different card (one hit of 115 at r=4.0, speed 800) from the live one (3 x 48 at r=3.5, speed 1100, 200 ms apart). That is not tuning. The engine should read waves and interval from data with defaults 1 and 0 so either vintage runs; choosing the vintage is a project decision, not a measurement.
  • The LAUNCH POINT, SPEED UNITS, AOE HIT TEST and CROWN-TOWER ROUNDING questions are shared with Fireball and have the same deciding observations.
  • Does the extractor's multiple_projectiles comment ('Whether 15 is visual arrows or damage waves is NOT established') still stand? Settled as visual: the 2017 card was a single hit per the wiki, and 2023 carries waves in a separate ProjectileWaves column. The comment in tools/extract_cards.py is stale and can be updated.

Engine test ideas (each with its plant)

  • arrows_2017_vintage_single_hit_ignores_deco: a Skeleton-army-sized stack under 2017 Arrows takes exactly 115 each, once. PLANT multiple_projectiles_as_damage (15 hits) and PLANT deco_projectile_as_damage_source (damage 0 or crown 100 read from cards[Arrows].projectile).
  • arrows_live_three_waves_four_ticks_apart: with ProjectileWaves 3 and interval 200 at TICK_MS 50, a stationary enemy Knight's hp drops on ticks T, T+4, T+8 by exactly the wave damage each. PLANT waves_simultaneous (all on T) and PLANT waves_missing_defaults_to_3 (a 2017 row without the column must stay single-hit).
  • arrows_one_hit_per_unit_per_wave: under W2 with overlapping sub-areas, a unit at the centre loses exactly one wave's damage per wave. PLANT per_subarea_hits.
  • arrows_waves_hit_test_at_each_arrival: a Hog Rider that leaves the disc between wave 0 and wave 1 takes only wave 0. PLANT hit_test_once_at_first_wave.
  • arrows_no_knockback: every unit in radius has the same position and attack_phase as a control run without Arrows (except for damage deaths). PLANT pushback_from_card_level (reads a Fireball-like 1800).
  • arrows_crown_tower_per_wave_ceil: princess tower loses 3 * ceil(122*20/100) = 75 over the cast. PLANT ct_floor (72).
  • arrows_mirror_symmetry: Blue Arrows at (x,y) vs Red Arrows at (x,32-y) on mirrored swarms give mirrored hp vectors and deaths on the same ticks. PLANT wave_release_uses_raw_entity_id_order.
  • arrows_save_load_between_waves: snapshot after wave 0 lands; the loaded run lands waves 1 and 2 on identical ticks with identical state_hash. PLANT save_drops_pending_waves.

docs.title: Shared mechanics
docs.text:
• CAST PIPELINE (all projectile spells: Fireball, Arrows, Rocket, Goblin Barrel's barrel). A deploy command validates with Territory::Anywhere, including river and buildings (live since 2018-04-25). In the next Spawn phase it enqueues SpellProjectile{team, source=caster KingTower id, pos=spells.LAUNCH_POINT, aim=tap point (fixed), speed=raw*projectile.SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK, damage carrier, release_ms}. It advances in the Projectile phase with fractional carry; on arrival it writes damage into the DamageBuffer and knockback into a parallel KnockbackBuffer, and resolves in one pass. Same-tick casts by both teams must be indistinguishable from either order. Sources: wiki Fireball/King's Tower (launch from the King's Tower); spells_other CustomDeployTime blank (no cast delay); engine TICK_PHASES convention.
  • DAMAGE CARRIER RESOLUTION. If spells_other.CustomFirstProjectile is set, it carries the damage and Projectile is visual (the 2017 Arrows and Princess pattern). Otherwise Projectile carries the damage. MultipleProjectiles is a visual or sub-area count, never a damage multiplier; waves are ProjectileWaves x ProjectileWaveInterval (2023+ columns, defaulting to 1 and 0 when absent). Loader gap as it stood when this spec was written, before any spell loaded: card.rs RawProjectileObj read only speed, damage and radius_milli, and ProjectileDef held {speed, radius}. pushback_milli, pushback_all, homing, aoe_to_air, aoe_to_ground, only_enemies, projectile-level crown pct and ignore_pushback (units) were never loaded, and card.rs rejected every Spell. That has changed: sixteen spells load at RoyaleSim 126992a, and a spell's knockback is read (mechanics.md).
  • CROWN TOWER REDUCTION ENCODING AND ROUNDING. CrownTowerDamagePercent raw is a delta from 100 (blank means 100). Cross-vintage evidence: 2017 -60 <-> 40% before 12/12/2017; 2023 -70 <-> 30% (2020-08-04); 2023 Rocket -75 <-> Supercell 371 = 25% of 1484; 2023 Log -80 <-> Supercell 58 = 20% of 290. Rounding: towers take dmg + trunc_toward_zero(dmgCTDP/100) (== ceil(dmg(100+CTDP)/100)). It reproduces all 8 Supercell-published level-11 values checked (7/7 non-circular); combat.rs::damage_against's floor reproduces 3/8 and round-half-up 5/8 (checked against the published level-11 values). 'Crown tower' means princess + king only (EntityKind::is_crown_tower); Cannon and Tesla take full damage.
  • AOE HIT TEST FOR SPELLS. Evaluated on the arrival tick; OnlyEnemies; AoeToAir/AoeToGround choose the flying/ground sets with height ignored; edge-inclusive (centre distance <= radius + victim collision radius) is the engine convention and is UNVERIFIED for spells. A crown tower is reached by the square of spells.CROWN_TOWER_SPELL_REACH instead (half-side 1000 round its centre, strictly below the radius; measured). Hidden entities (underground Tesla) are immune to projectile spells (no AffectsHidden column on projectiles.csv).
  • KNOCKBACK LAW (Fireball, Rocket, The Log, Bowler, Mega Knight spawn, Golem/Golemite death). Data semantics settled by cross-card and history checks. Pushback is a displacement DISTANCE in millitiles (Fireball 1800 <-> Supercell '1.8 tile'; Log 1000 <-> wiki '1 tile' 23/1/2017; Golemite 1800 -> wiki '0.9 (from 1.8)'). PushbackAll=TRUE overrides the victim's IgnorePushback: only Log, Monk and MegaCannon ship it (2023), and the wiki names exactly Log, Monk and Little Prince as pushing 'all ground troops'; the Log reset Prince/Dark Prince charge from 19/9/2016. PushbackAll=false does NOT mean primary-target-only (Fireball, Bowler and Mega Knight spawn all push many). There is no mass term in any column (Mass is collision-only; Tornado's push_mass_factor is a buff column). Direction is radial from the impact for area sources and along travel for rolling or piercing ones (COMMUNITY). Buildings and crown towers are never moved. Air units are pushed. A windup in progress is reset, not paused (COMMUNITY). The river does not block the push and ground units in water get resolved (COMMUNITY). Duration, zero-vector direction, stacking, water resolution, displacement falloff and deploy-state behaviour are NOT in any data (no globals key in 2017 or 2023) and must be calibration keys. Buffer the displacements and combine them commutatively; the zero-vector fallback must be mirror-symmetric (crforge's fixed (0,+1) is not).
  • IgnorePushback IS VINTAGE-DEPENDENT. Wiki Version History and 2023 characters.csv agree: pushback immunity was REMOVED from Battle Ram (2018-06-04) and from Inferno Dragon, Baby Dragon and Balloon (2018-08-06); ADDED to Cannon Cart (2018-08-06), Skeleton King (2021), Mighty Miner (2022) and Monk (2025-12-12). For the thin slice, the 2017 cards.json BabyDragon ignore_pushback=true is stale for the live target. The same 2023 file ships Prince CollisionRadius 600 (2017: 650), which is the vintage difference recorded in mechanics.md under "Open questions".
  • DATA VINTAGE FINDING. The vendored retroroyale data predates the Electrifying Update of 12/12/2017: Knight HitSpeed 1100, HogRider 1500 and Prince 1500 are that update's pre-change values, spell CT is 40%, and Bats/MegaKnight/SkeletonBalloon/DartBarrell/MovingCannon carry ReleaseDate 'Soon'. It postdates 12/6/2017 (Log ProjectileRange 11100) and 13/3/2017 (Arrows Speed 800). This contradicts cards.json provenance.roster_dating ('roughly the first half of 2018').
  • LIVE-2026 OVERLAY VALUES FOR THE FAMILY, each with a Supercell or wiki date. Fireball: Pushback 1000 (2022-08-02); CT 30% -> 25% (2026-06-01) -> ~23% (2026-09-08, 159 at L11); radius 2.5; speed 600; L11 damage 688. Arrows: 3 waves x 48 (L1) / 122 (L11), 200 ms apart; sub-area 1.4; spell radius 3.5 (2025-03-04); speed 1100 (2019-06-03); CT 20% (2026-06-01). Whether to load 2017 data, 2023 data, or a hand-sourced live overlay is a project decision (a vintage question, not a tuning choice).
  • DERIVED-DATA TRAPS. cards[Arrows].projectile is ArrowsSpellDeco (damage null, crown 100, radius null); the damaging object is cards[Arrows].spell.first_projectile. cards[Fireball|Arrows].spell.can_deploy_on_enemy_side=false and can_place_on_buildings=false come from BLANK 2017 cells (2023 rows are TRUE) and must not gate spell placement. The engine's Territory::Anywhere already ignores them.
  • PENDING DAMAGE (unsettled; affects towers retargeting while a lethal spell is in flight). 2017 and 2023 globals ship LOGIC_PENDING_DAMAGE_IGNORE_IF_DURATION_LESS=600 and (2023) CURRENT_TARGET_IGNORES_PENDING_DAMAGE=FALSE. Their semantics are not established, and it is not established whether in-flight spell damage counts as pending. Do not implement without an observation (for example, whether a princess tower keeps shooting a Skeleton that an in-flight Fireball will kill).

docs.title: Calibration keys proposed
docs.text:
• spells.LAUNCH_POINT: value 'caster_king_tower_centre', status community (wiki: launched from the King's Tower; exact origin unstated), confidence LOW; candidates caster_king_tower_centre | king_centre_plus_ProjectileStartRadius_toward_target | offscreen_behind_king. Promotion: flight-time regression over >=3 cast distances in >=2 directions from 60 fps video, fitting launch point and speed jointly.
  • projectile.SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK: value 15 (mirrors time.SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK), status hypothesis, confidence LOW; candidates 15 (Speed = tiles/min at 20 TPS; AesDragon assertion, crforge) | 18 (Speed/50 tiles/s; Darknighture frame test, Musketeer projectile 1000 -> 20 tiles/s). Kept separate from the troop key so a measurement can split them. Promotion: Fireball flight time over 20+ tiles (2.32 s vs 1.93 s over 23.16 tiles).
  • projectile.FLIGHT_PATH: value 'straight_ground_2d', status guess; candidates straight_ground_2d | ballistic_arc_from_Gravity. Promotion: flight time is linear in ground distance.
  • spells.CAST_DELAY_MS: value 0, status datamined (spells_other.CustomDeployTime blank for Fireball and Arrows in 2017 and 2023), confidence medium. Promotion: cast-frame to projectile-appearance frame in a recording.
  • spells.AOE_HIT_TEST: value 'edge_inclusive', status guess (engine convention from ADD_CHARACTER_RANGE_TO_RADIUS, not shown for spells); candidates edge_inclusive | centre_in_radius. Promotion: Knight centre at radius + 0.3 tile from a Fireball impact, hit or miss.
  • combat.CROWN_TOWER_DAMAGE_ROUNDING: value 'ceil_kept_share' (dmg + trunc_toward_zero(dmg*CTDP/100)), status community (Supercell patch-note level-11 values 8/8; floor 3/8; round 5/8), confidence medium; candidates ceil_kept_share | floor | round_half_up. Supersedes the unsourced floor in combat.rs::damage_against, so combat.DAMAGE_ARITHMETIC's note should strike 'TRUNCATED (floor)'. Promotion: princess tower HP readout before and after a spell impact in a recording.
  • knockback.DISPLACEMENT_LAW: value 'fixed_distance_radial', status community (Supercell wording 'Pushback: 1.8 tile -> 1 tile'), confidence LOW; candidates fixed_distance_radial | linear_falloff_with_distance | half_distance_constant_speed (crforge). Promotion: frame-tracked displacement of Knights at 0.5 and 2.3 tiles from the impact.
  • knockback.DURATION_MS: value 0 (instant) as placeholder, status guess, confidence LOW; candidates 0 | 500 (crforge, unsourced). Absent from 2017 and 2023 globals.csv. Promotion: 60 fps frame count of a Fireball knockback.
  • knockback.ZERO_VECTOR_DIRECTION: value 'caster_forward_y', status guess; candidates caster_forward_y | projectile_travel_direction | none. All must be mirror-symmetric. Promotion: Fireball centred exactly on a stationary unit.
  • knockback.STACKING: value 'vector_sum', status guess; candidates vector_sum | max_magnitude_with_mirror_invariant_tiebreak | latest_replaces. Promotion: two knockback sources landing on the same tick (Fireball + Log) on one Knight.
  • knockback.WATER_RESOLUTION: value 'eject_to_nearest_land', status guess (community confirms pushes cross the river and ground units 'bounce'); candidates eject_to_nearest_land | continue_along_push_to_far_bank | clamp_at_bank. Promotion: Fireball a Knight 0.3 tiles from the bank off-bridge.
  • knockback.RESETS_WINDUP: value true, status community (wiki Fireball 'true stun that resets the attack animations'; wiki The Log 'reset their attack animation'), confidence medium. Promotion: Musketeer shot timing with and without a mid-windup Fireball.
  • knockback.AFFECTS_DEPLOYING_UNITS: value true, status guess (damage during deploy is community-established; displacement is not). Promotion: Fireball on a Musketeer's placement frame.
  • arrows.WAVE_AREA_MODEL: value 'single_disc_spell_radius_one_hit_per_wave', status hypothesis (2023 data ships 10 x 1400-radius sub-areas, the wiki says the effective radius is unchanged, community kill counts imply one hit per wave), confidence LOW; candidates single_disc_one_hit_per_wave | ten_subareas_dedupe | ten_subareas_no_dedupe. Promotion: one-hit-kill Skeletons placed at radii 2.5-3.9 tiles and several angles across repeated casts.
  • data.PUSHBACK_IMMUNITY_VINTAGE: value 'vendored_2017', status datamined 2017, known stale for BabyDragon/Balloon/InfernoDragon/BattleRam (wiki 2018 changes, confirmed by 2023 characters.csv). A project decision, not a measurement: whether live-target runs override from the 2023 data.
  • data.SPELL_BALANCE_VINTAGE: value 'vendored_2017' (Fireball Pushback 1800, CT 40%; Arrows 1 x 115, r 4000, speed 800), live values (Fireball Pushback 1000, CT ~23%; Arrows 3 x 48 at 200 ms, r 3500, speed 1100, CT 20%). These are SHIPPED CARD DATA read from two vintages of the tables, not measurements of anything: the 2017 figures are the vendored spells_other/projectiles rows, the live ones are from the Supercell balance posts. Which of the two the engine runs was settled 2026-09-22 and is not an engine choice at all -- it is whichever vintage the loaded card table carries (see the ruling at the end of this page, and combat.CROWN_TOWER_DAMAGE_ROUNDING in the ledger for the arithmetic applied to it). A project decision on which to load; the engine must support both shapes (waves from data, default 1).

docs.title: Zap
docs.text:
Data chain. cards.json[name=Zap].spell.area_effect_object (damage_source area_effect_objects.Zap.Damage) -> spells_other.Zap.AreaEffectObject=Zap (ManaCost=2, Radius=2500 = indicator, no Projectile, CustomDeployTime blank) -> area_effect_objects.Zap.{Radius=2500, LifeDuration=1, HitSpeed=, Damage=75, CrownTowerDamagePercent=-60, Buff=ZapFreeze, BuffTime=500, OnlyEnemies=TRUE, HitsGround=TRUE, HitsAir=TRUE, AffectsHidden=, IgnoreBuildings=, NoEffectToCrownTowers=, MaximumTargets=, Pushback=, BuffTimeIncreasePerLevel=} -> character_buffs.ZapFreeze.{SpeedMultiplier=-100, HitSpeedMultiplier=-100, SpawnSpeedMultiplier=-100, ImmuneToAntiMagic=TRUE}; damage level scaling -> rarities.csv Common (cards.json Zap.level_scaling.multiplier_percent_by_level); reset switches -> globals.csv LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_WHEN_ZAPPED=TRUE, CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=FALSE, CLONE_RESET_TARGET=FALSE. All ~2018 vintage. EXTRACTOR GAP: tools/extract_cards.py norm_aeo does not emit AffectsHidden/BuffNumber/CapBuffTimeToAreaEffectTime/BuffTimeIncreasePerLevel/LifeDurationIncreasePerLevel/HitBiggestTargets/ControlsBuff and norm_buff does not emit EnableStacking/IgnorePushBack, so card.rs cannot read them from cards.json today (Zap's blank AffectsHidden is right only by the default).

L8 Minion 173 and L9 Goblin 169 survive); holds at every level 3..13 under the rarities.csv table with truncation hp COMMUNITY wiki Zap strategy section (live) x characters.csv Minion Hitpoints=90, Goblin Hitpoints=80 x Common table

Behaviour, in order

  1. DEPLOY: legal anywhere in the arena including the enemy side and the river, costs 2 elixir, no deploy timer. deploy() appends an AreaEffect record {team, pos, level, def=area_effect_objects.Zap, life_ms=1, pulse_acc_ms=0, applied=false}; no entity is spawned. Grid snapping and elixir/hand checks belong to the deploy code, not this family. [DATA spells_other.Zap CustomDeployTime blank; COMMUNITY wiki Zap 'deploys instantly', 2018-04-25 'allowed the Zap to be placed on the river']

  2. PHASE: the record is processed in the first tick N after the cast, in a new Phase::AreaEffect placed after Projectile and before Resolve. Reason: every writer of the damage buffer must come before Resolve (lib.rs), and pulses should see post-move positions, like projectile arrivals. TICK_PHASES and its phase-order test change in the same commit. [INFERENCE: placement is ours; a one-tick shift is unobservable]

  3. ONE-SHOT APPLICATION: HitSpeed is blank, so the AEO applies exactly once, on its first update, whatever LifeDuration says (LifeDuration=1 ms is shorter than a tick). Then life_ms -= TICK_MS. At <=0 the record is removed at the end of the phase. It never touches a unit that enters the radius later. [DATA LifeDuration=1, HitSpeed blank; COMMUNITY crforge OneShotHandler does the same]

  4. VICTIM SET: every alive entity with hp>0 whose team != record.team (OnlyEnemies; no friendly fire) that passes (flying ? HitsAir : HitsGround) (both TRUE) and is not hidden (AffectsHidden blank). Troops, buildings (IgnoreBuildings blank) and both crown towers (NoEffectToCrownTowers blank) all qualify. Deploying troops (deploy_ms>0) qualify. Geometry: fixed::in_range_edge(record.pos, victim.pos, milli(2500), victim.radius), i.e. the edge-to-edge reading the engine's splash already uses (UNSETTLED, see unsettled[0]); a crown tower by the square of spells.CROWN_TOWER_SPELL_REACH instead (measured). Candidates come from SpatialHash::neighbours_within(pos, milli(2500)+max_radius), which is index-sorted. There is no target cap, so no tie-break and no mirror asymmetry. [DATA OnlyEnemies/HitsAir/HitsGround/AffectsHidden; COMMUNITY wiki Zap kills a Skeleton Army or Bats as they deploy; hidden Tesla per supercell.com 2026-06-01]

  5. DAMAGE: amount = CardDb::scale(75, Common multiplier[level]), which is 159 at the engine default level 9. Each victim gets Hit{target, damage_against(kind, amount, crown_pct)} pushed into the DamageBuffer. crown_pct is the card's own CrownTowerDamagePercent, read from whichever card table this checkout built: 40 on the 2018 tables, 25 on a live one. It is card data, not a calibration key. The damage is summed and applied in Resolve with everything else, so a unit whose windup completes in tick N's Attack phase still lands that hit, and a unit Zap kills in tick N still swings in tick N. [DATA; simultaneous outcomes may not depend on entity order]

  6. BUFF: every victim also gets BuffApply{target, name=ZapFreeze, class=STUN (all three raw multipliers == -100), duration_ms=500, source=Aeo} pushed into a new BuffBuffer. [DATA area_effect_objects.Zap.Buff/BuffTime, character_buffs.ZapFreeze]

  7. RESOLVE (tick N), in this order. (a) Apply the damage buffer as today: sums, shields, deaths, king_hit. Zap damage on an inactive King Tower starts its activation. (b) Decrement existing stun timers by TICK_MS. This moves from phase_status to here so a D-ms buff suppresses exactly ceil(D/TICK_MS) ticks. (c) Apply the BuffBuffer to targets still alive after (a): stun_ms = max(stun_ms, 500). Merging is max plus OR, so buffer order is irrelevant. [DATA; COMMUNITY wiki Freeze 'may damage and activate it' (King); alignment is ours]

  8. ON STUN APPLICATION (each application, including a refresh). Set target_locked=false and retarget_on_resume=true (new per-entity bool, hashed and serialized). Reset charge state (Prince; implemented in state.rs::charge_pass, gated by tests/charge.rs) unless the source is the Clone buff and CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=FALSE. Reset the variable-damage ramp to stage 1 (Inferno; not in the thin slice). If load_first_hit && LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_WHEN_ZAPPED, set attack_phase=Idle and attack_ms=0 (Sparky; not in the thin slice). Leave attack_phase and attack_ms UNCHANGED for every other attacker. [COMMUNITY supercell.com 2017-03-13, verified at source: 'All stun/freeze effects will now pause the target's attack, causing them to retarget when they resume. Exceptions are Sparky, Inferno Tower and Inferno Dragon, which will still be reset'; same post 'Clone: No longer resets charging troops (Princes, Sparky, etc.)'; wiki Zap 'reset charging attacks from ... Prince'; DATA globals.csv LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_WHEN_ZAPPED=TRUE, CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=FALSE, CLONE_RESET_TARGET=FALSE]

  9. WHILE STUNNED (ticks N+1..N+10). Target phase: the stun's landing clears the target and releases the lock (status.STUN_CLEARS_TARGET = client_cleared, measured on client 15.535.29); no scan while held. Path phase: no movement proposal (already). Move phase: the unit can still be displaced by collision separation and knockback. Attack phase: attack_step(can_act=false) freezes phase and ms (already). REQUIRED FIX: phase_attack currently sets target_locked = preserve && phase==Windup every tick, which re-locks a stunned unit in Windup; gate it on stun_ms==0. Also frozen: spawner timers and the Tesla hide/emerge timers (a stunned Tesla cannot retreat). Still running: deploy_ms, building lifetime_ms, king_wake_ms, the buff timers themselves. A projectile the unit has already launched keeps flying. [DATA HitSpeed/Speed/SpawnSpeed -100; COMMUNITY wiki Freeze 'Troops frozen by the Freeze will remain frozen even if they are pushed out of the Freeze's radius'; wiki Freeze 'will not affect the King Tower's activation animation'; wiki Rage 'building lifetime still drops with its normal rate, even with the Rage'; wiki Tesla 'The retreat can also be stopped with a Freeze spell'; INFERENCE for deploy_ms and in-flight projectiles]

  10. RESUME (tick N+11, the first tick whose Target phase sees stun_ms==0 and retarget_on_resume). The Target phase bypasses target lock and keep-target hysteresis (LOGIC_RANGE_EXTENSION_TO_KEEP_TARGET) and runs target::scan() as for a fresh unit, then clears the flag. If scan returns the previous target, windup or cooldown resumes exactly where it paused, and phase_attack re-locks it. If it returns a different target, the paused windup carries onto it (status.RESUME_RETARGET_WINDUP = carry, measured on client 15.535.29; cancel, to Idle, is the old arm). Buildings and crown towers retarget too. [COMMUNITY supercell.com 2017-03-13 'causing them to retarget when they resume'; wiki Zap 'Zapping units or the opposing Crown Tower can possibly change their targets' (X-Bow example); wiki Rage 'unlike the Zap, it does not force the Crown Tower to retarget']

  11. OVERLAP: a second stun (another Zap, an E-Wiz hit, Freeze, Lightning) sets stun_ms = max(remaining, new) and never shortens a longer one. Step 8's resets fire again at each application. Retarget happens once, when the last stun ends. [INFERENCE: ZapFreeze has no EnableStacking and different buff names coexist in Supercell's buff model; COMMUNITY supercell.com 2017-03-13 'Electro Wizard: No longer permanently stuns' is consistent with pause+refresh; crforge AppliedEffect.refresh uses max]

  12. TESLA: a revealed Tesla is damaged and stunned and cannot retreat while stunned. A hidden Tesla is excluded from the victim set. Hide is implemented: entity.rs::HideState and state.rs::hide_pass read hides_when_not_attacking / hide_time_ms / up_time_ms, target.rs and combat.rs::resolve honour it, and tests/hide.rs gates it. [DATA buildings.csv Tesla HidesWhenNotAttacking=true, HideTimeMs=800, UpTimeMs=800; COMMUNITY wiki Tesla; supercell.com 2026-06-01]

  13. PRINCE: stun resets his charge; after the stun he must build the charge up again from zero. Charge is ABSENT, so step 8 is a call-out the charge implementation must make. Knockback (Log) resets charge through the same call-out (other family). [COMMUNITY wiki Zap, wiki Freeze, supercell.com 2017-03-13 Clone note; wiki Sparky 'The knockback from The Log will also reset the charge of the Prince']

  14. DETERMINISM: the AreaEffect list and retarget_on_resume go into state_hash and the save/load snapshot, alongside projectiles. Zap has no randomness and no capped target selection. Its mirror is a Red Zap at (x, 32-y), under the 180-degree seat symmetry.

Targets affected. Enemies only (OnlyEnemies): own troops, buildings and towers are never damaged or stunned (no friendly fire). Ground and air troops (HitsGround, HitsAir). Enemy buildings (IgnoreBuildings blank): Cannon always; Tesla only while not hidden (AffectsHidden blank; hidden Tesla is immune to both damage and stun). Enemy crown towers, Princess and King (NoEffectToCrownTowers blank): damaged at the card's CrownTowerDamagePercent, which the loaded card table supplies (2018 raw -60 = 40%; a live table gives Zap 25%, L11 48) and stunned (their attack pauses and they retarget on resume). Damage on an inactive King activates it; the stun does not delay that activation. Deploying troops are hit. No knockback, no target cap, no level-scaled stun duration.

Which crown-tower percent runs, and which card levels exist. Settled 2026-09-22: neither is a choice the engine makes. Both come from the card table this checkout built, and the tables differ. Of the 2018 tables' 15 spells, 5 carry a crown percent and all 5 say 40: Fireball, Arrows, Rocket, Zap and Log. The other 10, Lightning and Poison among them, leave the column blank, and a blank column loads as 100. Of a live table's 27 spells, 11 carry one and they differ from each other: Log 13, Arrows 20, Rocket 23, Fireball, Freeze, Zap and Snowball 25, and four at 100. The engine reads the percent per card, so there is no single number to ship. The exception is where the ledger overlays a value measured on the 16.402 corpus on the 15.535 table (cards.CLIENT16402_VALUES): the Fireball runs at 23% there, not 25%. The level ladder comes from the same table's rarities: 13 levels for a 2018 Common and 16 for a live one. Battles run at the lowest level every rarity has, which is 9 on the 2018 tables and 11 on a live one (CardDb::lowest_level_valid_for_every_rarity).

Unsettled

  • AEO radius geometry. (E) victim hit if dist(centre, victim) <= 2500 milli + victim CollisionRadius, the engine's splash convention and ADD_CHARACTER_RANGE_TO_RADIUS by analogy. (C) centre-to-centre, dist <= 2500 milli. Nothing public states which, and the Zap / AesDragon hidden-stats wiki pages are silent. Deciding observation: cast Zap with its centre 2.6-3.0 tiles from a stationary enemy Cannon (radius 0.6); under E the Cannon loses HP and flashes stunned, under C it is untouched. A tile-snapped building keeps the geometry exact, and the 0.5-0.6 tile margin is well above video error.
  • Windup on retarget-to-a-different-target at resume. SETTLED: P2, carry (status.RESUME_RETARGET_WINDUP, measured on client 15.535.29). (P1) the paused windup is cancelled to Idle and a full LoadTime is paid on the new target; this is the engine's existing 'changed && Windup -> Idle' rule. (P2) the paused progress carries over. Deciding observation: a Musketeer locked mid-windup on a far Giant, a Skeleton dropped nearer, then Zap. Measure new-target hit time minus stun end: ~remaining windup under P2, a full LoadTime under P1.
  • Pause vs reset in the LIVE 2026 game. The 2017-03-13 official note (pause) predates the 2018 data, and the live wiki Freeze and E-Wiz pages still say pause; no later reversal was found. crforge implements reset, the pre-2017 model. Deciding observation (O1): a Knight or Giant attacking a building, Zapped at a known offset t after a hit lands. Pause gives a hit-to-hit interval of HitSpeed+500 ms for every t. Reset gives t+500+LoadTime: shorter than pause when zapped early in cooldown, longer when zapped late in windup. That is categorical at 60 fps.
  • Tick alignment of buff expiry. (a) ceil(D/TICK_MS) ticks from the tick after application: 10 for Zap, the recommended default. (b) one tick fewer: 9, what the shipped phase_status decrement would produce. There is no deciding observation at video resolution (50 ms vs 16.7 ms, under client interpolation), so this is ours and pinned by a test. NOTE: the calibration.json TICK_MS promotion rule suggests timing 'Zap stun start to end' to settle the tick rate. A 500 ms buff lasts 500 ms under every tick hypothesis, so that measurement is far weaker than it reads.
  • Crown-tower damage rounding for Zap (feeds combat.DAMAGE_ARITHMETIC). Truncation is contradicted: the official L11 value was 58 at 30% and 19230/100 = 57.6. Round-half-up and ceil both fit (Fireball's official 207 at 30% of wiki 688 = 206.4 fits ceil only, but 688 itself may be a rounded display). Assumes the published number equals battle damage. Deciding observation (O4): Zap a crown tower at card level 8 (144.7525% = 36.19: trunc/round 36, ceil 37) and at level 12 (210.75*25% = 52.69: trunc 52, round/ceil 53), reading the tower's displayed HP number before and after.
  • Does a stun applied during deploy pause deploy_ms? (D1) no, both timers run and only stun left after deploy blocks action. This is the recommended default, by analogy with the Freeze wiki's King activation note. (D2) yes. Deciding observation (O6): Zap a Knight about 0.8 s into its 1 s deploy. D1: starts walking about 1.3 s after placement. D2: about 1.5 s.
  • Is a Tesla hittable during its retreat and emerge animations, or only when fully up? The wiki says 'the retreat is not instant, enabling quick troops ... to get a hit off before it goes underground', which suggests the transition counts as not hidden. It belongs with the hide mechanic itself, but is_hidden() must be defined before Zap can be gated on it.
  • Semantics of BuffNumber, blank on Zap and 1 on Rage/Freeze/Poison/Heal. Candidates: max stacks per target from one AEO; applications per target; unused. Irrelevant to a one-shot Zap. It matters for pulsing AEOs, where a Poison with EnableStacking re-applied every 250 ms would otherwise hold 4 stacks and deal 4x its DPS.
  • One-shot AEOs with LifeDuration longer than a tick (Freeze 4000 ms, not in thin slice). (O1) apply once at the first update. (O2) apply to each new entity entering during life. Weak support for O2: wiki Freeze says death-spawned units 'remain frozen until the duration of the Freeze ends', though buff inheritance by death spawns explains that equally. Zap is insensitive: LifeDuration=1 makes O1 and O2 identical. Deciding observation (O7): walk or deploy an enemy troop into an active Freeze 1 s after cast.
  • ImmuneToAntiMagic=TRUE on ZapFreeze/Freeze/Poison/Stun. No 2018 row sets NegatesBuffs or applies an anti-magic buff, so there is no consumer and no observable. Record it, do not implement it.
  • EXTRA_BUFF_RADIUS=2000 (globals.csv). No 2018 character uses AreaBuff, so the meaning is unknown: extra radius for AreaBuff auras, or a buff-linger margin around AEOs. No consumer for Zap.
  • Whether stunned units still push and get pushed in collision separation. The recommended default is yes: the Freeze wiki's 'pushed out of the Freeze's radius' implies displacement while frozen. Who does the pushing is not stated. Deciding observation: a stunned Knight in the path of a friendly Giant walking into it.

Engine test ideas (each with its plant)

  • zap_damages_and_stuns_for_exactly_ceil_buff_ticks. An enemy Knight (L9) stands still with no target. A Blue Zap (L9) is cast before tick N. Assert hp drops by exactly 159 in tick N's Resolve, the Knight proposes zero movement and does not advance attack_ms in ticks N+1..N+10, and moves again at N+11. PLANT stun_decrement_at_status_start (keep the shipped Status-phase decrement) must turn it red (only 9 ticks).
  • stun_pauses_windup_and_cooldown_not_resets. A Red Knight attacks a Blue building and is zapped (a) 300 ms into its windup and (b) 100 ms into its cooldown. Assert the next hit tick equals the unzapped baseline hit tick + 10 ticks in both cases. PLANT stun_resets_attack (Idle/0 on application, crforge's model) must go red: later than baseline+10 in (a), earlier in (b). Needing both cases stops a plant that only moves the time one way from passing.
  • stunned_unit_is_not_relocked_each_tick. A unit zapped mid-windup must show target_locked==false on every stunned tick. PLANT relock_while_stunned (restore the ungated target_locked = preserve && Windup in phase_attack) must go red.
  • zap_forces_retarget_on_resume. A Red Musketeer is locked on a far Blue Giant, and a Blue Skeleton is placed nearer, inside keep-target hysteresis so it is NOT chosen without Zap. Control run with no Zap: the target stays the Giant for 40 ticks, so the test is not vacuous. Zap run: the target becomes the Skeleton on tick N+11, not before. PLANT no_retarget_after_stun (resume keeps the old target) must go red. PLANT retarget_at_application (scan during the stun) must also go red.
  • zap_hits_enemies_only. A Blue Zap over an overlapping Blue Knight and Red Knight: the Blue Knight's hp and stun_ms stay unchanged, the Red Knight takes 159 and a 500 ms stun. PLANT aeo_ignores_team must go red.
  • zap_hits_air_ground_buildings_and_crown_towers. Red Minions (air), a Red Knight, a Red Cannon and a Red Princess tower all inside the edge-radius: each takes damage; the tower takes damage_against(PrincessTower, 159, 40) = 63 and gets stun_ms=500. PLANT aeo_skips_air, PLANT aeo_crown_pct_ignored (full 159 on the tower) and PLANT aeo_skips_buildings must each go red.
  • zap_radius_is_edge_to_edge_under_default_reading. A Red Knight (radius 500 milli) with its centre exactly milli(2500)+milli(500) subtiles from the Zap centre is hit; one subtile farther is not; with centre-to-centre reading selected, the first position is not hit. PLANT aeo_centre_radius must turn the default-reading assertion red. Distances squared must be i64: (45000+9000)^2 is about 2.9e9 > i32::MAX.
  • zap_is_one_shot. A Red unit placed so it enters the radius one tick after the cast tick takes no damage and no stun. PLANT aeo_applies_every_tick (treat blank HitSpeed as 'pulse each tick while alive', with life_ms extended) must go red. PLANT aeo_expires_before_applying (remove the record before processing when LifeDuration < TICK_MS) must go red, because the unit inside the radius at cast is then never hit.
  • zap_kill_thresholds_match_wiki_across_levels. For every Zap level L in 3..13 (Common table), Minions at L-2 die and at L-1 survive; Goblins at L-1 die and at L survive. Assert these from hp after one Zap. PLANT pow11_level (existing) must go red, since 1.1^(L-1) drifts at the thresholds. So must a plant that rounds the level product up instead of truncating (e.g. Zap L3 91 vs Minion L2 99 still survives, but other pairs flip; assert the table explicitly).
  • refresh_never_shortens_a_longer_stun. Use a test-only buff from inline card JSON (like card.rs tests): a 2000 ms STUN, then a Zap 500 ms later. Assert stun_ms after the Zap's Resolve equals 1500 minus one tick, not 500. PLANT stun_replace (stun_ms = new) must go red. Also assert that swapping the two buff entries in the same tick's BuffBuffer gives an identical state_hash (order independence).
  • same_tick_swing_lands_before_stun. A Red Knight whose windup completes in tick N is zapped in tick N. Assert its hit is in tick N's DamageBuffer and resolved, and the Zap still applies. PLANT aeo_before_attack_inline (process AEOs before Attack and set stun immediately) must go red.
  • stun_does_not_pause_lifetime_king_activation_or_deploy. Zap a Red Cannon: lifetime_ms still falls by TICK_MS each stunned tick. Zap the Red King Tower: king_wake_ms counts up through the stun and activation happens at KING_ACTIVATE_TIME_MS after the hit. Zap a deploying Red Knight: deploy_ms keeps decreasing. PLANT stun_pauses_all_timers must go red.
  • zap_state_is_hashed_and_snapshotted. Cast Zap, snapshot before the tick, load, and step both: equal state_hash. Then step a unit into resume. PLANT hash_skips_aeo (drop the AEO list from state_hash) must make the determinism gate red on a pair of runs whose AEO lists differ. PLANT save_drops_aeo must make save_load red. PLANT hash_skips_retarget_flag must go red.
  • zap_mirror_symmetry. A Blue army plus Blue Zap at (x, y) against the mirrored Red army plus Red Zap at (x, 32-y) cast the same tick. Assert mirrored hp, stun_ms and targets on both sides every tick. PLANT buff_merge_in_slot_order (apply buffs inline in slot order with a first-writer-wins guard) must go red.
  • SPEC GATE, lands with Tesla hide: zap_does_not_touch_hidden_tesla. An underground Red Tesla inside the radius keeps full hp and stun_ms==0, and a revealed Tesla is damaged and stunned and does not retreat during the stun. PLANT aeo_affects_hidden must go red. Re-anchor as a failing test with a sentence, landed in the same commit as hide.
  • SPEC GATE, lands with charge: zap_resets_prince_charge. A Red Prince with charge accumulated is zapped: charge progress is 0 after the stun and the next hit deals Damage, not DamageSpecial, unless he re-accumulates. PLANT stun_keeps_charge must go red. A Clone-sourced -100 buff with CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=FALSE must NOT reset it (PLANT clone_resets_charge must go red).

docs.title: Shared mechanics
docs.text:
• BUFF MULTIPLIER ENCODING [DATA cross-row + COMMUNITY]. character_buffs Speed/HitSpeed/SpawnSpeedMultiplier: pct(raw) = 100 if blank/0, raw if raw>0 (absolute percent), 100+raw if raw<0 (delta), clamped at 0. Evidence: Rage +135 = +35% (wiki Rage 2016-11-01..2025-10-06); IceWizardSlowDown -35 = -35% (2018); ChargeSpeedMultiplier 200 = 2x; newer crforge data keeps the pattern (Rage 130, IceWizard -30, ArcherQueenRapid 280). No shipped positive value below 100 exists, so the reading of e.g. 50 is untested. Implement as integer percent. Movement uses speedpct/100 with the existing move_frac carry. Attack and spawn timers advance by TICK_MSpct/100 per tick with a remainder carry kept in state (not needed while only -100 buffs exist in the thin slice).
  • HIT-SPEED MULTIPLIER IS A TIMER RATE [INFERENCE, strong]. Attack windup and cooldown timers advance at pct% of real time; the reading 'the period is scaled' is rejected. The -100 limit of the rate reading is exactly the official 2017 behaviour ('pause the target's attack'). The period reading has no sensible -100 limit. Rage +35% therefore makes a 1.5 s attack take 1.111 s, not 0.975 s. The wiki Rage line 'an X-Bow can shoot 4 projectiles every second' weakly favours the rate reading.
  • STUN CLASS [DATA + COMMUNITY]. A buff is STUN-class iff its speed, hit-speed and spawn-speed raw multipliers are all -100: ZapFreeze, Freeze, Stun and Clone in 2018 data. Freeze and ZapFreeze behave identically (official 2017 note says 'stun/freeze effects'). Sources: AEO Buff (Zap, Freeze, E-Wiz spawn Zap), projectile TargetBuff (LighningSpell ZapFreeze 500, IceSpiritsProjectile Freeze 1500 applied to every entity its AoE damages), character BuffOnDamage (ElectroWizard ZapFreeze 500 per damaging hit). The existing single stun_ms timer is sufficient for the whole class: stun_ms = max over every active STUN-class buff.
  • STUN EFFECTS [COMMUNITY supercell.com 2017-03-13, verified at source]. On application: the target lock is cleared; retarget_on_resume is set; charge is reset (skipped for Clone while CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=FALSE); the variable-damage ramp is reset; LoadFirstHit attack timers are reset when LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_WHEN_ZAPPED=TRUE. Ordinary windup and cooldown are PAUSED, not reset. While stunned: no movement proposal, no target change, frozen attack/spawn/hide timers. Still running: deploy, building lifetime, king activation and buff timers. At resume the unit does a fresh scan() that ignores lock and hysteresis. Clone also skips the target reset while CLONE_RESET_TARGET=FALSE.
  • ONE INTERRUPT ROUTINE, SEVERAL CAUSES. Implement interrupt(i, cause) once. cause=StunApplied does the step-8 resets above. cause=Knockback (other family) resets the attack windup outright: COMMUNITY wiki Freeze 'It is not like The Log's effect, where the attack animation of affected units will be completely restarted'. It also resets charge (wiki Sparky: Log knockback resets Prince charge). Clone-sourced stuns take the CLONE_RESET_* opt-outs. Charge (Prince) is implemented (state.rs::charge_pass, tests/charge.rs) and the routine must reset it; the Inferno ramp is modelled too (combat.VARIABLE_DAMAGE), and a stun restarts it (state.rs).
  • BUFF BUFFER AND MERGE [INFERENCE; simultaneous outcomes may not depend on entity order]. No writer sets a timer inline. AEO pulses, projectile arrivals and on-damage handlers push BuffApply{target, name, class, duration_ms, source_kind, source_id}. Resolve applies them after damage, skipping targets that died. Merge for a non-stacking name: duration = max(existing, all new). Reset flags are OR-ed. Commutative, so slot and writer order cannot matter. EnableStacking=TRUE (Poison, Heal, Tornado) means one instance per source object (per AEO id) coexisting with others, refreshed by that same source. Re-application every pulse cannot add stacks, or Poison's 250 ms pulses with a 1000 ms buff would triple its damage.
  • BUFF TICK ALIGNMENT (ours). A buff of D ms applied during tick N is active for ticks N+1..N+ceil(D/TICK_MS). Implement by decrementing buff timers in Resolve immediately BEFORE applying that tick's new buffs, not at Status start (which yields one tick fewer), and update lib.rs Phase::Status docs. Tick N itself can never be suppressed because Attack runs before Resolve.
  • AREA EFFECT OBJECT LIFECYCLE [DATA columns; INFERENCE timing]. A record {team, pos, level, def, life_ms, pulse_acc_ms, applied, source_id} lives in state beside projectiles, is hashed and snapshotted, and runs in a new Phase::AreaEffect after Projectile and before Resolve. One-shot (HitSpeed blank/0): apply on the first update regardless of LifeDuration (Zap 1 ms). Pulsing: pulse_acc += TICK_MS; while pulse_acc >= HitSpeed {pulse; pulse_acc -= HitSpeed}. The first pulse is therefore at t = HitSpeed, not t = 0: Lightning 1500/460 gives the known 3 bolts; t=0 would give 4. life_ms -= TICK_MS after processing, remove at <=0. Level-scaled life: LifeDuration + LifeDurationIncreasePerLevel*(level steps) (Rage, Freeze; semantics of the step base unverified).
  • AEO VICTIM FILTER [DATA]. alive && hp>0. Team: OnlyEnemies => enemy of record.team; OnlyOwnTroops => same team. flying ? HitsAir : HitsGround. IgnoreBuildings => skip non-troops (whether this covers crown towers is unverified). NoEffectToCrownTowers => skip crown towers. AffectsHidden false => skip hidden entities (Tesla underground), for both damage and buff. MaximumTargets caps the set, and HitBiggestTargets picks by hp; any cap needs the engine's mirror-invariant tie-break key, never EntityId. Geometry uses in_range_edge with the victim's radius by default (UNSETTLED); a crown tower is reached by the square of spells.CROWN_TOWER_SPELL_REACH instead (measured). Candidates come from the index-sorted spatial-hash query.
  • AEO DAMAGE AND BUFF AMOUNTS [DATA]. damage = CardDb::scale(Damage, rarity multiplier at the card level; for character-spawned AEOs, SpawnAreaObjectLevelIndex). Per victim use damage_against(kind, damage, crown_pct) with crown_pct = 100 + raw when raw < 0 (cards.json convention; Zap -60 = 40% matches the wiki's pre-2017-12-12 Zap value). buff_time = BuffTime (+ BuffTimeIncreasePerLevel). With CapBuffTimeToAreaEffectTime, buff_time = min(buff_time, the area's life left after the application's tick plus one HitSpeed of the area) (status.AREA_BUFF_SOURCE_BINDING; measured on the Earthquake, client 15.535.29, and the Rage, client 16.402). So the Rage's last application, with 250 ms left after its tick, lasts 550 ms and the buff outlives the area by 250 ms, where wiki Rage says it 'will always expire once the spell's duration ends'. ControlsBuff (Tornado) removes its buff from every entity when the record dies. Damage-over-time buffs deal DamagePerSecond*HitFrequency/1000 per HitFrequency with their own crown percent (not in thin slice; first-tick timing unverified).
  • MULTI-BUFF COMPOSITION (not needed for the thin slice) [COMMUNITY, conflicting]. Candidates for combining non-stun speed buffs: (M1) multiplicative product (crforge's choice, no source); (M2) additive sum of deltas (fits wiki 'Rage can be used to neutralize the Ice Wizard's slow effect'); (M3) strongest slow wins among slows, combined with the strongest boost (fits wiki Ice Wizard 'does not stack with ... Giant Snowball and Ice Golem' and 'overwritten by the Earthquake and Ram Rider ... more severe'). STUN-class buffs yield zero action under all three, so Zap is insensitive. This is implemented: status.rs carries a per-entity buff list with each buff's raws, and movement.BUFF_SPEED_COMPOSITION = strongest_up_and_down is the arm it runs (M3).
  • ENGINE CONSUMER GAPS STILL OPEN. (1) phase_attack re-sets target_locked for stunned units in Windup every tick. (2) tools/extract_cards.py still drops BuffNumber, Life/BuffTimeIncreasePerLevel, HitBiggestTargets, ControlsBuff (AEO) and IgnorePushBack (buff), so card.rs cannot honour them from cards.json. AffectsHidden, CapBuffTimeToAreaEffectTime and EnableStacking are emitted now; the buff list of status.rs replaced the dead slow timer, and Tesla hide is implemented (state.rs::hide_pass, tests/hide.rs).
  • PROJECTILE SPEED UNITS (overlaps the projectile family) [COMMUNITY, weak]. The wiki user blog 'AesDragon/Hidden card stats: Projectile travel speeds' states projectile Speed uses 'the same kind of measurement as troops do' (tiles per minute) and tabulates values equal to projectiles.csv Speed (Fireball 600, Arrows 1100, Log 200, Lightning 500). No source was found for a separate /60-vs-/50 divisor for projectiles; this is an assertion, not a measurement. The engine already uses one SPEED_TO_SUBTILES_PER_TICK for both, flagged UNVERIFIED in card.rs.
  • VINTAGE CAUTION ON crforge [COMMUNITY]. crforge resets attack state on stun/freeze (resetAttackState: windup, cooldown, accumulatedLoadTime, targetLocked). That is the pre-2017-03-13 model Supercell replaced with pause+retarget. Its buffs.json and cards.json are newer than the 2018 data (Zap crown -70 = 30%, Rage 130, IceWizard -30, Poison speed -15) but predate 2026-06-01, and their provenance is undocumented.

docs.title: Calibration keys proposed
docs.text:
• status.STUN_ATTACK_TIMER_MODEL = "pause" | status: sourced-community (Supercell release note 2017-03-13, verified at source; live wiki Freeze/E-Wiz pages agree) | confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH for 2026 (no later reversal found, nine years old) | alternatives: "reset" (pre-2017, crforge) | promotion: deciding observation O1, hit-to-hit interval after a Zap at two phase offsets is HitSpeed+500 (pause) vs offset+500+LoadTime (reset).
  • status.STUN_RETARGET_ON_RESUME = true | status: sourced-community (Supercell 2017-03-13 'causing them to retarget when they resume'; wiki Zap X-Bow example) | confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH | promotion: deciding observation O2, a locked Musketeer or Hog with a nearer valid target placed after the lock switches target 0.5 s after a Zap.
  • status.RESUME_RETARGET_WINDUP = "carry" | status: measured (client 15.535.29: the paused windup carries onto the resume rescan's new target; shipped since the 2026-09-28 round 9 arms flip) | confidence: HIGH | alternatives: "cancel" | promotion: deciding observation O2 variant with the switch mid-windup; new-target hit time minus stun end is a full LoadTime (cancel) or the remaining windup (carry).
  • status.BUFF_EXPIRY_TICK_ALIGNMENT = "ceil_from_next_tick" | status: ours (not a property of the game we can observe) | confidence: n/a | alternatives: "one_tick_short" (the shipped Status-phase decrement) | promotion: none by video (below interpolated-frame resolution); pinned by engine test zap_damages_and_stuns_for_exactly_ceil_buff_ticks.
  • status.BUFF_MULTIPLIER_ENCODING = "positive_absolute_negative_delta" | status: datamined-pattern (Rage 135 = +35%, IceWizard -35 = -35%, 2018 wiki percentages) | confidence: HIGH for single buffs | promotion: already consistent with 2018 wiki; re-confirm with one Rage traversal time if a rage source ever enters the slice.
  • status.HIT_SPEED_MULTIPLIER_MODEL = "timer_rate" | status: inference (the -100 limit reproduces the official pause) | confidence: MEDIUM | alternatives: "period_scale" | promotion: time a Raged or Ice-Wizard-slowed Knight's hit interval; 1100/1.35=815 ms vs 1100*0.65=715 ms under +35%.
  • status.MULTI_BUFF_COMPOSITION = "unset" | status: guess, not needed for the thin slice | confidence: LOW | alternatives: "multiplicative" (crforge), "additive_deltas" (wiki 'Rage neutralizes Ice Wizard slow'), "strongest_slow_plus_strongest_boost" (wiki Ice Wizard 'overwritten by ... more severe') | promotion: Ice Wizard slowing a Knight inside Rage; walk speed 1.0x (additive), 0.8775x (multiplicative).
  • status.SAME_BUFF_REAPPLY = "refresh_max" | status: inference (no EnableStacking on ZapFreeze; crforge refresh) | confidence: MEDIUM | alternatives: "replace" | promotion: Zap a unit 1 s into an Ice Spirit freeze (1.1 s live); under replace it moves at 1.5 s after the freeze began, under max at 1.1 s.
  • status.STUN_PAUSES_DEPLOY_TIMER = false | status: inference (analogy to wiki Freeze 'will not affect the King Tower's activation animation') | confidence: LOW | promotion: deciding observation O6, Zap a Knight 0.8 s into deploy; walk starts about 1.3 s (false) or about 1.5 s (true) after placement.
  • status.STUN_PAUSES_BUILDING_LIFETIME = false | status: sourced-community by analogy (wiki Rage 'building lifetime still drops with its normal rate, even with the Rage') | confidence: MEDIUM | promotion: Freeze a Cannon (4 s) and time its total lifetime; ~30 s vs ~34 s at 2018 LifeTime.
  • status.STUN_PAUSES_KING_ACTIVATION = false | status: sourced-community (wiki Freeze) | confidence: MEDIUM | promotion: Freeze an enemy King at the moment it is first damaged; it attacks immediately when the freeze ends (false) or after a further activation delay (true).
  • aoe.RADIUS_GEOMETRY = "edge_to_edge" | status: guess (engine splash convention, by analogy with ADD_CHARACTER_RANGE_TO_RADIUS) | confidence: LOW | alternatives: "centre" | promotion: deciding observation O3, Zap centre 2.6-3.0 tiles from a stationary Cannon; hit => edge_to_edge.
  • aoe.FIRST_PULSE_AT = "hit_speed" | status: inference (Lightning 1500/460 yields the known 3 strikes only if the first pulse is at 460 ms) | confidence: MEDIUM | alternatives: "zero" | promotion: time Lightning's first strike after cast on video (~0.46 s vs immediate).
  • aoe.ONE_SHOT_APPLICATION = "first_update_only" | status: inference (Zap LifeDuration=1; crforge OneShotHandler) | confidence: HIGH for Zap, LOW for Freeze | alternatives: "each_new_entity_during_life" | promotion: deciding observation O7, walk a unit into an active Freeze 1 s after cast.
  • aoe.PHASE_POSITION = "after_projectile_before_resolve" | status: ours | confidence: n/a | alternatives: "spawn_phase_pre_move" | promotion: none (one tick of movement, below video resolution); record the choice in architecture.md and pin it with the TICK_PHASES test.
  • targeting.CLONE_RESET_TARGET = false, targeting.CLONE_RESET_CHARGE = false, targeting.LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_WHEN_ZAPPED = true, targeting.LOGIC_LOAD_FIRST_HIT_RESET_TIMER_AFTER_ATTACK = true | status: datamined (globals.csv ~2018) | confidence: HIGH for 2018; CLONE_RESET_CHARGE=false corroborated by the Supercell 2017-03-13 Clone note | promotion: vendor newer globals data; not needed for the thin slice except LOAD_FIRST_HIT (no thin-slice consumer).
  • combat.DAMAGE_ARITHMETIC evidence to attach (existing key, do not re-create) | status stays guess | new evidence: Supercell 2026-06-01 published Zap L11 crown damage 58 at 30% of an exact 192 (=75*256/100); truncation gives 57, so the current truncating damage_against is contradicted if the published value equals battle damage | promotion: deciding observation O4, Zap at card level 8 and 12 on a crown tower; tower HP number deltas 36/37 and 52/53 separate trunc, round and ceil.

docs.title: Log
docs.text:
Data chain. RAW: spells_other.Log.{ManaCost=2, Projectile=LogProjectile, SpellAsDeploy=true, CanPlaceOnBuildings=TRUE, CanDeployOnEnemySide=(blank), OnlyEnemies=true} -> projectiles.LogProjectile.{Speed=360, MinDistance=3000, Gravity=30, Radius=1950, RadiusY=600, AoeToGround, OnlyEnemies, no Damage, SpawnProjectile=LogProjectileRolling} -> projectiles.LogProjectileRolling.{Damage=240, Speed=200, ProjectileRadius=1950, ProjectileRadiusY=600, ProjectileRange=11100, Pushback=1000, PushbackAll=true, CrownTowerDamagePercent=-60, MinDistance=2500, AoeToGround=true, AoeToAir=(blank), OnlyEnemies=true}; victim flags characters..IgnorePushback (cards.json units[].ignore_pushback / cards[].ignore_pushback) and FlyingHeight (flying); scaling rarities.Legendary (RelativeLevel 8, multipliers 100,110,121,133,146). DERIVED: cards.json cards[name=Log].projectile(=LogProjectile).spawn_projectile(=LogProjectileRolling).{damage, speed, projectile_radius_milli, projectile_radius_y_milli, projectile_range_milli, pushback_milli, pushback_all, crown_tower_damage_percent=40, crown_tower_damage_percent_raw=-60}; cards[name=Log].spell.{spell_as_deploy=true, can_place_on_buildings=true, can_deploy_on_enemy_side=false}; cards[name=Log].level_scaling. TRAPS: cards[name=Log].area_damage_radius_milli=1950 is lifted from the AIRBORNE LogProjectile.Radius (which has no damage) -- do not splash the tap with it; cards[name=Log].spell.pushback_milli is null because the pushback lives on the rolling projectile.

Numbers

name value units tag source elixir cost 2 elixir DATA spells_other.Log.ManaCost (2018 data); fandom The_Log live 2 rolling damage at Legendary local level 1 (= engine unified level 9) 240 hitpoints DATA projectiles.LogProjectileRolling.Damage (data 2017-10..2017-12); live fandom L9 220, L11 266 after 2025 nerfs rolling damage at unified L11 / L13 (engine truncating scale) 290 / 350 hitpoints DATA 240 x rarities.Legendary 121% / 146% crown tower damage percent 40 (raw -60, read as 100+raw) percent of damage, King and Princess towers DATA LogProjectileRolling.CrownTowerDamagePercent; fandom history says 40% until 2017-12-12, which corroborates the delta-from-100 reading; live 13% since 2026-06-01 (raw would be -87) crown tower damage at unified L9 96 hitpoints DATA 240*40/100 truncating (combat.rs damage_against) rolling speed (raw) 200 raw Speed column; subtiles/tick = 200 x projectile speed multiplier = 3000 at k=15 (/60 @20TPS) or 3600 at k=18 (/50 @20TPS) DATA LogProjectileRolling.Speed == fandom history 'projectile speed to 200' (2016-10-20, unchanged since) airborne (cast) speed (raw) 360 raw Speed; 5400 subtiles/tick at k=15, 6480 at k=18 DATA LogProjectile.Speed == fandom 'casting speed to 360' (2016-10-20); AesDragon blog: airborne phase has no hitbox roll distance 11100 millitiles = 199800 subtiles (2018); live 10100 = 181800 distance along team-forward axis from the tap point to the roll end DATA LogProjectileRolling.ProjectileRange == fandom 'rolling distance 11.1' (2017-06-12..2020-08-04); live 10.1 (fandom stats) half-width (x half-extent) 1950 millitiles = 35100 subtiles distance perpendicular to roll DATA LogProjectileRolling.ProjectileRadius; fandom Width 3.9 = 2x1.95 (live, unchanged) half-depth (along roll) 600 millitiles = 10800 subtiles distance along roll INFERENCE LogProjectileRolling.ProjectileRadiusY; semantics (rectangle half-depth) not stated by any source knockback distance 1000 millitiles = 18000 subtiles (2018); live 700 = 12600 total displacement of a struck ground troop DATA LogProjectileRolling.Pushback == fandom 'pushback range to 1 tile' (2017-01-23..2023-02-07); live 0.7 tiles since 2023-02-07 PushbackAll true flag: knockback ignores the victim's IgnorePushback COMMUNITY LogProjectileRolling.PushbackAll (only projectile in projectiles.csv with it); fandom 2016-09-19 'allowed The Log to push back all ground troops'; fandom strategy 'unlike most other cards with a pushback effect ... can affect all ground troops' airborne MinDistance 3000 millitiles = 54000 subtiles distance;
